custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a dual-indicator scoring system: Trend = sign(MA_fast - MA_slow) + sign(RSI_fast - RSI_slow), yielding values from -2 to +2. At SignalBar (default bar 1), Trend is evaluated. Then a historical scan from SignalBar+1 forward finds the LastTrend (the first non-zero res value). A BUY_Open signal requires Trend>0 at SignalBar AND LastTrend<0 (trend reversal from bearish to bullish). A SELL_Open signal requires Trend<0 at SignalBar AND LastTrend>0 (trend reversal from bullish to bearish). Signal execution only happens on new bars (CIsNewBar guard) or when Recount is true. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans act as permission gates that can independently disable long/short entry and exit. UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime are set to last bar datetime + TimeShiftSec, passed to trade functions as signal timestamps. All trade execution logic is encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh which is not shown.
python_conversion_notes: The core signal logic is straightforward: dual RSI comparison + dual MA comparison combined into a trend score, with reversal detection by comparing current vs historical trend. The main conversion challenge is TradeAlgorithms.mqh which handles all order execution, position sizing (conditional on MM sign), and position management. The MM parameter logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be reimplemented. The CIsNewBar class and LoadHistory function also come from the .mqh. The custom indicator ColorMaRsi-Trigger is only used in visual testing mode and can be ignored for trading logic. SL/TP are passed as point values to trade functions - verify whether TradeAlgorithms.mqh applies any digit adjustment internally. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous completed bar, typical for on-bar strategies. No digit adjustment is visible in the EA code itself.
